:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-score .solution}

Differentiating the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik) from @sol-prac-exp-mle:

$$
\ba
\score(\pmean; \vx)
&= \deriv{\pmean}\paren{-n\logf{\pmean} - \frac{n\bar{x}}{\pmean}}
\\
&= -\frac{n}{\pmean} + \frac{n\bar{x}}{\pmean^2}
\\
&= \frac{n}{\pmean^2}\paren{\bar{x} - \pmean}
\ea
$$

:::
